svg.text: Reusable elements for Harmonic Orbit UI
Used on the Circle of Fifths — inner ring for diatonic, outer ring for notes
Width proportional to beat length. Background grid at 1-beat intervals.

g.text: Active pill uses function color fill. Inactive uses surface + border.
Active = function color fill. Inactive = surface + border.

svg.text: Ranked chord suggestions with multi-reason explanation

g.text: Top-ranked suggestion — prominent border, full confidence bar
Lower-ranked — default border, shorter confidence bar
Borrowed suggestion — dashed border, magenta color
Playing state — accent border, stop button
